item.title: WebSocket vs SSE Benchmark: SSE Uses 40% Less Memory at 100K Connections
item.description: Ark Protocol's real-world benchmark comparing WebSocket and SSE at 100K concurrent connections. SSE saves 40% memory. Plus a practical decision guide for your next real-time project.

item.title: Go Memory Allocator: A Warehouse Manager's Tale
item.description: From 64MB warehouses to 8KB shelves, discover how Go's three-level cache architecture makes memory allocation blazing fast. Deep dive into arena, span, and size class design philosophy.

item.title: Rust Compiler Pipeline Refactor: 35% Faster Build Times, But There's a Catch
item.description: Our team's CI dropped from 42 minutes to 27 minutes just by upgrading the Rust compiler. This journey taught us one thing: performance optimization rewards those who measure, punishes those who guess.

item.title: 10x Performance Boost Secret: 99% Don't Know These Go Concurrent GC Tricks
item.description: Production latency dropped from 500ms to 50ms! Deep dive into Go's tri-color marking algorithm, write barriers, and GOGC tuning. Say goodbye to lag forever.

item.title: Frontend Performance Optimization: I Replaced Axios With 25 Lines of Vanilla JS
item.description: Discovered that 13KB Axios is just a fetch wrapper. Using 25 lines of vanilla JS to achieve the same functionality while reducing bundle size by 92%. A real frontend performance optimization case.

item.title: Python Finally Got Fast: JIT Compiler Makes Code Performance Take Off
item.description: Python 3.15 introduces a native JIT compiler that delivers 20% performance improvements without changing a single line of code. Here's how to enable this experimental feature.

item.title: Rust Compile Time Optimization: From 22 Minutes to 38 Seconds with One Config Change
item.description: Staring at cargo build? Speed up your Rust compilation from 22 minutes to 38 seconds by switching to a faster linker. Complete guide to mold and lld linker configuration.

item.title: When My Fitness App Was Lagging Like a Slideshow, Rust Came to the Rescue
item.description: React Native makes cross-platform app development easy, but complex calculations can be a headache? Here's how I used Rust to solve performance bottlenecks

item.title: HTML Speculation Rules API Tutorial: 6 Lines of Code for Instant Page Loads
item.description: Complete guide to HTML5 Speculation Rules API for prefetching and prerendering web pages. Achieve 90% faster page loads with 6 lines of HTML code. Includes Chrome 121+ implementation and cross-browser compatibility solutions.
